package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class C4 extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  private Clock.Ticket b;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), x, null); b = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(9), y, null); }
  public void stopped() throws Exception { super.stopped(); cancelAll(); }
  private void cancelAll() { cancelA(); if (b != null) b.cancel(); }
  private void cancelA() { if (a != null) { a.cancel(); a = null; } }
}
